title: Crystal Night Heron Statue
text: Found in loot crystal balls in Crystal Workshops. The purple front button changes its colors; interact with the upper half or apply a redstone signal to switch walking and standing poses.
May produce Milk Suspension after a neck-stretch cycle. The white rear button toggles production. Facing the front button, place a container to the right of the base to collect it.
Wandering traders have a 5% chance to offer a Crystal Night Heron Statue for 32 emeralds.
